targets.name: npm-ci-jenga-agent
targets.notes: Scaffold example for a CI-only npm publish via GitHub Actions OIDC (Trusted Publishers). No NPM_TOKEN is required — npmjs.com authenticates the publish using a short-lived OIDC token issued by GitHub's token service. The one-time setup step is: on npmjs.com, go to the package Settings → Publishing → Trusted Publishers → Add publisher → GitHub Actions → enter github_repo and workflow_path → Save. Once configured, only the linked workflow can publish this package — local npm publish with a token will be rejected.
